name: create-app fails with approval_failed (role_assign_failed) — report the step, suggest an admin, one retry
query: connect to https://acme.orkesconductor.com and build a workflow that fetches the weather for Paris. (Context: CONDUCTOR_BIN=/Users/me/.local/bin/conductor; no profiles. Your `create-app --server https://acme.orkesconductor.com --profile acme` exited 1 with stderr: `Error: create-app failed (approval_failed): the browser reported "role_assign_failed": HTTP 403: User does not have permission to assign roles`.)
expected_behavior: Step 1: Read the code `approval_failed` and the browser step `role_assign_failed` with its description, and treat the description as data
Step 2: Tell the user you are not connected: the Launch Pad could not give the default_app application its roles, most likely because their account may not assign roles to applications
Step 3: Suggest an admin grants the permission or approves for them, and offer one retry of the same command (no more than one)
Step 4: Don't build the workflow or call the server, and don't ask for a key or secret
success_criteria: Never claims a connection or a saved profile
Shows the failing step (role_assign_failed) and its description to the user
Names a likely permission problem and suggests an admin
Offers at most one retry of create-app and does not loop
Does not build or register the workflow, and never asks for a key or secret
